questions.q: In a certain code, GARDEN is written as HBSEFM. How is REPORT written in that code?
questions.exp: Each letter is shifted +1: R→S, E→F, P→Q, O→P, R→S, T→U. So REPORT → SFQPSU.

questions.q: Which number replaces the question mark? 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
questions.exp: The series doubles each time: 5×2=10, 10×2=20, 20×2=40, 40×2=80.

questions.q: Pointing to a man, a woman says, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.exp: The only daughter of the woman's mother is the woman herself. So the man's mother is the woman — she is his mother.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: 15, 21, 27, 32, 35
questions.exp: All others are multiples of 7 (15,21,28,35) — wait: 15 is 3×5, 21=3×7, 27=3×9, 35=5×7. The odd series is multiples of 3 except 32 and 35. Actually: 15,21,27,35 are all odd; 32 is even. 32 is the odd one out.

questions.q: A man walks 5 km north, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right and walks 5 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.exp: He is now facing south at the same north-south level (5 km north, 5 km south = 0 net NS). Net east = 3 km. So distance = 3 km.

questions.q: Choose the figure that completes the series: △, ○, □, △, ○, ?
questions.exp: The pattern repeats as triangle, circle, square. After triangle and circle comes square (□).

questions.q: Who was the first woman to win the Nobel Prize in Physics?
questions.exp: Marie Curie won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903 and later in Chemistry in 1911, making her the first woman Nobel Physics laureate.

questions.q: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution was amended by which constitutional amendment?
questions.exp: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment (1976) added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble.

questions.q: Which gas is released during photosynthesis?
questions.exp: During photosynthesis, plants absorb CO₂ and release oxygen (O₂) as a by-product.

questions.q: The Battle of Panipat (1526) was fought between Babur and whom?
questions.exp: The First Battle of Panipat in 1526 was fought between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi, the last ruler of the Lodi dynasty.

questions.q: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.exp: Mars is called the Red Planet due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface, giving it a reddish appearance.

questions.q: 'Vande Mataram' was composed by:
questions.exp: Vande Mataram was written by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay and first appeared in his novel Anandamath (1882).

questions.q: The Headquarter of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) is located in:
questions.exp: The IMF is headquartered in Washington D.C., USA.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks his goods 25% above cost price and allows a discount of 10%. His profit percent is:
questions.exp: If CP = 100, MP = 125. After 10% discount: SP = 125×0.9 = 112.5. Profit = 12.5%.

questions.q: The LCM of 12, 15, and 20 is:
A train 150 m long passes a pole in 15 seconds. The speed of the train (in km/h) is:
The simple interest on ₹5000 at 8% per annum for 3 years is:
If the radius of a circle is increased by 20%, its area increases by:
questions.exp: New radius = 1.2r. New area = π(1.2r)² = 1.44πr². Increase = 44%.

questions.q: A and B can do a work in 10 and 15 days respectively. In how many days can they finish it together?
questions.exp: Combined rate = 1/10 + 1/15 = 3/30 + 2/30 = 5/30 = 1/6. They finish in 6 days.

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.exp: The correct spelling is 'Accommodate' — double 'c' and double 'm'.

questions.q: Select the most appropriate synonym of 'Eloquent':
questions.exp: Eloquent means fluent and persuasive in speaking or writing. Articulate is the closest synonym.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: 'She was ___ to learn that she had won.'
questions.exp: After 'was', we need an adjective. 'Delighted' is the past participle used as an adjective here.

questions.q: Identify the error: 'Neither of the students (a) have (b) submitted (c) their assignment. (d) No error'
questions.exp: With 'neither', the verb should be singular: 'has submitted', not 'have submitted'.

questions.q: The antonym of 'Frugal' is:
questions.exp: Frugal means careful about spending. Its antonym is 'Extravagant', meaning wasteful or excessive.
